name: Feature or behaviour change
about: Specify the behaviour precisely enough to implement without questions

## Goal

What changes, for whom, and the command or recipe it enables.

## Rule

The exact behaviour in one or two sentences. State the default when the
answer would otherwise be ambiguous.

## Examples

Inputs and exact expected output.

## Edge cases

| case | behaviour | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

## Unchanged

Behaviour that must stay byte-identical.

## Out of scope

What this issue deliberately does not change.

## Documentation

Which places change: the header comment of `zfind.asm`, `help_msg`,
`README.md`, or `AGENTS.md`? Write `none` if the change is internal.
